excerpt: You create quotes and invoices in your own design fulfilling all mandatory information.
Personalise your invoices with your logo, create reusable text blocks and choose from a range of layouts. Add your own letterhead.
Scan your receipts with the mobile app, upload them using drag & drop or send them directly to your sevdesk inbox.
Receive a suggestion for the right booking category automatically.
Send your advance VAT return directly to your tax office. Thanks to our integrated interface to ELSTER, it’s two clicks away.
In your dashboard, you can see your income and expenses, your VAT liability and other relevant information that you need to manage your company.
Send data and files to your tax advisor via the interface or invite them to collaborate in your sevdesk account.
Seamlessly merge your business account and bookkeeping and pay your invoices directly from sevdesk. We already support over 4,000 banks and neobanks.
Map invoices directly to your bank payments. See when receipts are missing.
ZUGFeRD and XRechnung e-invoicing standards
Create professional quotes that comply with GoBD requirements, and send them by email or post via our mailing interface for confirmation. You can also apply customer-specific discounts.
Create a dunning notice for an overdue invoice and send it directly from sevdesk. This feature lets you manage every stage of your internal dunning process.
Work digitally with your tax adviser, with secure access to receipts, reports and tax-related settings.
Expand your features with a wide range of partner integrations. Use interfaces to work more efficiently and transfer data automatically.
Double-entry bookkeeping is carried out using a chart of accounts.
sevdesk prepares a cash-basis income statement from your income and expenses.
Your assets are automatically recognised from expense receipts and depreciated correctly
Turn an accepted quote into a legally compliant order confirmation containing the items you quoted and their corresponding quantities.
Any subsequent documents, such as the invoice, will automatically use the same reference.
Record cash income and expenses for your business—ideal for petty cash. Your cash report is just one click away.
The trial balance gives you a detailed view of your accounts and journal entries.
Assign invoices and receipts to different cost centres. You can then filter by cost centre and analyse the income and expenses assigned to each one.
The REST API lets you manage data and features in sevdesk and connect external services to sevdesk. The API documentation helps you build your own solutions.
Create a real-time business analysis report (BWA) based on current data from your digital bookkeeping in sevdesk.

sevdesk publishes its full OpenAPI 3.0.0 document (671 KB YAML, base https://my.sevdesk.de/api/v1) as a downloadable file that is also the source its Redoc reference at api.sevdesk.de renders directly.

Scope of the testing surface: "For testing our API, we would always recommend to create a trial account for sevdesk to prevent unwanted changes to your main account" ("A trial account will be in the highest tariff (materials management), so every sevdesk function can be tested!") - a separate real account rather than a sandbox mode, with production tokens ("The api tokens have an infinite lifetime"). The reference is Redoc standalone with no request runner; the spec recommends external tools ("To start testing we would recommend one of the following tools:" Postman, cURL).

sevdesk documents per-resource versioning: "We use resource versioning to handle breaking changes for our endpoints, these are rarely used and will be communicated before we remove older versions", selected per request via the X-Version header (default, 1.0 through 1.9; unknown versions error with the available list), with a Deprecation response header ("If a resource is deprecated we return true or a timestamp since when") and a documented account-level sevdesk-Update 2.0 transition. Caveat: header-based resource versions over a fixed /api/v1 base, and no single notice-window policy page.

sevdesk maintains a dated API changelog on its tech blog ("API News"; "Endpoints and data streams. Integration and expansion. You and our API.") with breaking-change announcements carrying dated notice ("Breaking change: new API pagination limits": "By 30.05.2025, we will introduce a restriction on our pagination limits for API calls that retrieve data.") and release posts such as "Breaking Changes Q1 2026" and the sevdesk-Update 2.0 changes post.
